name: Magic Starknives Trap

stealth.details: to spot the magical energies reverberating in the pillars

disable: DC 21 Thievery check (expert) or Dispel Magic on any four of the six pillars disables the entire trap (the trap is a 2nd-rank spell and the DC to dispel it is 21). Destroying any four of the six pillars also disables the trap.
reset: The trap deactivates 1 round after it has no target creatures and resets each day at sundown.
routine: (3 actions) For each of its actions on its turn, a carving on a different pillar glows and makes a magical starknife Ranged Strike against a random creature within range. Creatures might have cover from this Strike, such as from one of the pillars in the room.

items.name: Starknife Attack
items.text: If a creature passes the middle pair of pillars, both doors leading out of the room slam shut and lock; while the trap is active, the doors must be battered open with a successful DC 23 Athletics check check or sufficient damage (Hardness 12; HP 48 [BT 24]). One of the starknife carvings glows with light, detaches from the pillar, and then flies outward, making a magical starknife Ranged Strike against a random creature within range. The trap then rolls initiative with its Stealth modifier of +12

text: Starknife symbols on the six pillars glow and shoot across the room.
